name: Gabe Newell
note: Video game magnate; The Heart of Racing racing team 'receives backing through video game magnate Gabe Newell, who founded Heart of Racing in 2014' (Sportscar365, 4 Oct 2023). Aston Martin's own Valkyrie announcement (4 Oct 2023) says The Heart of Racing was 'Founded in 2014 by American businessman and philanthropist Gabe Newell'.
